name: US dollar
summary: Dollar index near 102.3 on 6 Nov, up 2.5% over three months
state: The DXY dollar index closed near 102.3 on 6 Nov, up 2.5% over three months and near its 52-week high of 102.6 (Yahoo Finance), inside the 5% Watch line and the 90–108 range. No dollar funding strain is visible as of 8 Nov.
for_you: A firm dollar makes US-priced goods and travel slightly dearer for sterling and euro users.
rubric_hit: DXY 3m move 2.46% below the 5% Watch line
why: The dollar is the world's funding currency; violent moves squeeze emerging markets and anyone with dollar debts.
drivers: Fed vs other central banks, safe-haven demand, trade policy, reserve diversification.

rubric.alert: DXY moved > 8% in 3 months, or dollar funding stress (Fed swap lines drawn materially).
rubric.watch: DXY moved 5–8% in 3 months, or outside 90–108.
rubric.normal: DXY moved < 5% over 3 months and is between 90 and 108.
